subject: English
passage: The Velvet Room is a 1931 play by Trinidad Castillo set in a Madrid literary salon. In the play, Adela attends an evening poetry reading. Adela compares her artistic discernment favorably to that of the other salon guests who listen alongside her:___
prompt: Which quotation from The Velvet Room best illustrates the claim?

choices.A: "Taken one by one, their taste struck her as thin; yet when they nodded together in approval, Adela bowed to their verdict as though it were the judgment of the salon itself."
choices.B: "Adela, seated beneath the tall window at the edge of the room, let her gaze drift from the reader's lectern to the faces arranged in a half-circle around it."
choices.C: "Adela felt herself plainly the superior of these polished guests of the salon; she had probably read more deeply, listened more attentively, and weighed more verses in private, than any other listener in the room."
choices.D: "To arrive at Dona Inez's salon on foot was, among the younger poets, thought nearly as respectable as arriving by a hired coach."

explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most effectively illustrates the claim that Adela compares her artistic discernment favorably to the other salon guests. The quotation directly states that Adela "felt herself plainly the superior of these polished guests of the salon" and provides specific evidence of this comparison: she had "probably read more deeply, listened more attentively, and weighed more verses in private, than any other listener in the room."
